notes: Nationality dimension — simple a_containedBy on debrief:platforms[*].nationality. DE = 15 items in sample catalog.
Domain dimension — compound array_filter(platforms, domain='surface'). 47 items carry at least one surface platform.
Vessel-role dimension — array_filter(platforms, vessel_role='carrier'). 7 items include a carrier.
Exercise dimension — title LIKE '%Saxon Warrior%'. All 73 items in the sample catalog are from this exercise.
Tag dimension — a_containedBy on debrief:tags with 'ASW'. 33 items are tagged.

Track-name dimension (substituted for the spec's 'year' dimension — year is not a first-class FilterType in the current schema; track-name is). a_containedBy on debrief:platforms[*].name. 12 items feature HMS Nelson.
Compound platform predicate — array_filter(platforms, and(nationality='GB', vessel_role='frigate')). 21 items match the conjunction.
US3 case (c) — entirely out-of-vocabulary phrase. unrecognisedTerms populated; cql2 must be {} and must NOT leak those terms (FR-013).
US3 case (a) — unknown nationality code. 'navy' is a generic English word with no FilterType mapping, so only 'ruritanian' surfaces as unrecognised; cql2 is empty.
US3 case (b) — one recognised (UK → GB) + one unrecognised ('warbirds'). cql2 filters on GB (54 items); 'warbirds' appears in unrecognisedTerms and must NOT leak into cql2.
